findings.test_name: Erythrocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
findings.clinical_note: Low RBC consistent with anemia; progressive decline suggests ongoing loss or decreased production.

findings.test_name: Hematocrit [Volume Fraction] of Blood by Automated count
findings.clinical_note: Reduced hematocrit mirrors RBC and hemoglobin decline; supports anemia diagnosis.
Borderline low hemoglobin consistent with normocytic anemia; trending downward.

findings.test_name: Leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
findings.clinical_note: Upper‑normal leukocyte count with rising trend may indicate early infection or inflammation.

findings.test_name: Platelet [Entitic mean volume] in Blood by Automated count
findings.clinical_note: Slightly elevated MPV suggests larger, possibly more reactive platelets.

findings.test_name: Platelet distribution width [Entitic volume] in Blood by Automated count
findings.clinical_note: Markedly high PDW indicates heterogeneous platelet size; may reflect activation or technical artifact.

findings.test_name: Erythrocyte [DistWidth] in Blood by Automated count
findings.clinical_note: RDW at lower end of normal; borderline low may suggest uniform red cell size.
